verses.text: Brothers and sisters, I want you to remember what happened to our ancestors. They were all led by the cloud, and they all passed safely through the sea.
They were all baptised into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.
They all ate the same spiritual food,
and they all drank the same spiritual drink. They drank from the spiritual rock that went with them, and that rock was Christ.
But God was not pleased with most of them, and their bodies were left in the desert.
These things happened as examples for us, so that we will not want evil things as they did.
Do not worship idols, as some of them did. As the Scriptures say, "The people sat down to eat and drink, and got up to dance and party."
We must not commit sexual sin, as some of them did. In one day twenty-three thousand of them died.
We must not test Christ, as some of them did. They were killed by snakes.
Do not grumble, as some of them did. They were killed by the destroying angel.
These things happened to them as examples. They were written down to warn us, who are living near the end of the ages.
So if you think you are standing firm, be careful that you do not fall.

No temptation has come to you except what everyone faces. God is faithful. He will not let you be tempted more than you can bear. When you are tempted, he will also give you a way out, so that you can stand up under it.
So, my dear friends, run away from idol worship.
I am speaking to sensible people. Judge for yourselves what I say.
When we give thanks for the cup at the Lord's Supper, are we not sharing in the blood of Christ? When we break the bread, are we not sharing in the body of Christ?
Because there is one loaf, we who are many are one body, for we all share the one loaf.
Think about the people of Israel. Those who eat the sacrifices share in the altar.
What do I mean? That food offered to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?
No. I mean that what people who do not know God sacrifice is offered to demons, not to God. I do not want you to share with demons.
You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too. You cannot eat at the Lord's table and at the table of demons too.
Are we trying to make the Lord jealous? Are we stronger than he is?
You say, "I am allowed to do anything." But not everything is helpful. "I am allowed to do anything," but not everything builds people up.
No one should look out only for themselves. Look out for the good of others.
Eat anything sold in the meat market without asking questions to ease your conscience.
For the Scriptures say, "The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord."
If someone who does not believe invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat whatever is put in front of you without asking questions to ease your conscience.
But if someone tells you, "This was offered to an idol," then do not eat it. Do this for the sake of the person who told you, and for the sake of conscience.
I mean their conscience, not yours. Why should my freedom be judged by someone else's conscience?
If I eat with thanks to God, why should I be blamed for eating food I have thanked God for?
So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.
Do not cause anyone to fall into sin, whether Jews, Greeks or God's church.
I try to please everyone in every way. I am not looking for what is good for me, but for what is good for many people, so that they may be saved.
